name: sevens-out
description: Sevens Out dice game: static page + room server (Cloudflare Durable Object or Node).

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/engine.test.js tests/fortytwo.test.js tests/schocken.test.js tests/room.test.js tests/node-server.test.js tests/worker.test.js tests/d1.test.js tests/stats.test.js tests/access.test.js tests/queries.test.js tests/admin.test.js tests/webauthn.test.js tests/accounts-store.test.js tests/sqlite.test.js tests/accounts.test.js
scripts.db:schema: wrangler d1 execute sevens-out-stats --remote -c server/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --file server/d1/schema.sql
scripts.db:accounts: wrangler d1 execute sevens-out-stats --remote -c server/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --file server/d1/migrations/0001-accounts.sql --yes
scripts.db:rooms: wrangler d1 execute sevens-out-stats --remote -c server/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --file server/d1/migrations/0002-rooms.sql --yes
scripts.db:kinds: wrangler d1 execute sevens-out-stats --remote -c server/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --file server/d1/migrations/0003-kinds.sql --yes
scripts.test:worker: node tests/e2e/d1-setup.mjs && TARGET=worker playwright test tests/e2e/online.spec.js tests/e2e/players.spec.js tests/e2e/account.spec.js tests/e2e/fortytwo.spec.js tests/e2e/schocken.spec.js
scripts.db:flags: wrangler d1 execute sevens-out-stats --remote -c server/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --file server/d1/migrations/0004-flags.sql --yes
